[Ranger](https://github.com/ranger/ranger) is a command line file manager with a minimalistic vim-inspired interface.

## Enabling

To use ranger, add it to configuration.nix:

### Adds file glyphs / icon support to Ranger

Follow the instructions in: [ranger_devicons](https://github.com/alexanderjeurissen/ranger_devicons)

You will also need to install <a href="Fonts#Installing_specific_nerdfonts" class="wikilink" title="Nerdfonts">Nerdfonts</a>.
